name: UPDF
summary: PDF editor for Windows, Mac, iOS and Android: edit, convert, OCR, annotate, organise and sign PDFs, with an optional AI assistant to summarise, translate and chat with documents. One licence covers 4 devices.
best_for: individuals and small teams who want a full PDF editor on Windows, Mac and mobile under one licence, and who like the option to pay once
skip_if: you only fill in and sign the odd PDF, which a free reader handles, or you need team admin and central licence management, which UPDF sells separately as an enterprise plan
honest_knock: The prices on the pricing page are campaign prices that change with each sale, so the figure you see may differ from ours. The AI Assistant is a separate yearly subscription even on a lifetime licence, and the bundle card starts a 7-day AI trial that renews at US$69 a year. The free version puts a trial watermark on edited files. Refunds are at UPDF's discretion under its refund policy, and a subscription has to be cancelled 3 days before it renews.

pricing.entry_price_terms: UPDF Pro Yearly · Black Friday sale price on 4 November 2026 (list US$89.99), auto-renews yearly, 4 devices
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-04 on updf.com/pricing-individuals, US dollars) On 4 November the pricing page ran a Black Friday sale, so these are sale prices with the list price struck through. UPDF Pro, the full set of PDF tools on up to 4 devices, cost US$54.99 a year (list US$89.99) with 10 GB of cloud storage and 20 basic e-signatures a year, or US$84.99 once for a lifetime licence (list US$139.99) with 2 GB and 50 basic e-signatures in total. The most popular card bundles Pro with a 7-day trial of the AI Assistant: US$0 for the AI part today, then it renews at US$69 a year unless you cancel. The AI Assistant is always a yearly subscription, also next to a lifetime licence, and it adds unlimited document AI (summarise, translate, chat with PDFs), 100 GB more cloud storage and 1,000 AI credits a month. The free version lets you try everything, but edits, annotations and page changes get a trial watermark, conversion is limited to 2 files a day and OCR to 5 uses. Prices and discounts change with each campaign, so check the page on the day you buy.
